question: A consultant sets project instructions telling Claude to always respond as a financial advisor, then separately uploads quarterly earnings reports to the same project's knowledge base. When the consultant opens a brand-new chat in that project, what should they expect?
options: A) Claude requires the consultant to manually re-enable the instructions and knowledge base for each chat
B) Claude applies the advisor persona but cannot access the reports until they are re-uploaded in that chat
C) Claude ignores the persona instructions in new chats but can still access the earnings reports fully
D) Claude applies the advisor persona and references the earnings reports, since both persist project-wide
correct_answers: D) Claude applies the advisor persona and references the earnings reports, since both persist project-wide
explanations: Incorrect. Neither instructions nor knowledge base content require manual re-enabling per chat; both are automatically active project-wide.
Incorrect. Knowledge base files are available project-wide and do not need to be re-uploaded inside each individual chat.
Incorrect. Project instructions apply to all chats in the project, not selectively to some and not others.
Correct. Both project instructions and knowledge base uploads are designed to persist and apply automatically across every chat within the same project, including new ones.
